content.short: Cream Finance is a DeFi protocol allowing users to stake tokens and quickly obtain loans.
content.description: Cream Finance is a decentralized, permissionless, and blockchain-agnostic lending protocol. It operates on Binance Smart Chain, Ethereum, Polygon, and Fantom, allowing users to stake a variety of coins to borrow and lend assets such as ETH, USDC, and others. The protocol's native token, CREAM, enables borrowing, lending, staking, and revenue sharing from token swaps, while giving holders a voice in governance and protocol upgrades.
